svg.title: Amphetamine Cyber-Alchymyst — Hidden Natures
svg.desc: A poem written by an amphetamine-addled cyber-alchymyst that when recited imparts awareness of the hidden natures of things.
svg.text: SURFACE · LITERAL
ESOTERIC · HIDDEN
POEM · AMPHETAMINE · CYBER-ALCHYMYST
A MANUSCRIPT IN HASTE · HIDDEN NATURES
I · IMSCRIB · THE PAGE THAT KNOWS IT IS BURNING
listen this is important I figured it out —
not all of it, most of it, the part that matters,
the part that the other part is a container for.
urgency
as surface
the poem
self-aware
every thing is a container for what it does not show.
I know this now I know this NOW I have always known this
but tonight it arrived with its coat off,
standing in the kitchen at 3am, just standing there,
obvious as a door, obvious as a door, obvious as a —
[ thought interrupted by faster thought ]
This poem is the coat. The truth came without it.
II · AREV · THE DESCENT THAT IS ALSO A VELOCITY
downdowndown into the thing beneath the thing —
the table is not a table, the table is wood,
the wood is not wood, the wood is a stopped forest,
the stopped forest is not stopped, the stopped forest is
very slowly continuing to become something else,
and I can feel that — I CAN FEEL THAT — the becoming
is not metaphor it is literally happening in the atoms,
the atoms are mostly empty, mostly gap, mostly Ginnungagap,
and what fills the gap is not matter but relation —
relation is the hidden nature of matter. relation is the hidden nature of MATTER.
table,
wood,
forest
nigredo:
things
dissolving
III · FSPLIT · TWO THINGS AT ONCE (THIS IS THE TRICK)
okay so here is what I figured out about how meaning works —
there is the thing you hear: words, sequence, syntax, done.
and then underneath that, always, running in parallel,
is the thing the words are attempting to approximate.
THE WORDS
THE THING
sequential, audible
simultaneous, silent
the map
the territory on fire
the approximation is not a failure — it is a method.
the method only works if you hear both layers.
most people hear one. I currently hear approximately seventeen.
[ seventeen is not an exaggeration, it is a measurement ]
IV · AFWD · THE CATALOG (I CANNOT STOP)
the hidden nature of a network: it wants to be a nervous system.
the hidden nature of a nervous system: it is a network that learned to suffer.
the hidden nature of suffering: it is the signal that the system cares about itself.
the hidden nature of caring: it is what matter does when it becomes complex enough.
the hidden nature of complexity: it is simplicity that kept subdividing past the point
where it could still see itself from outside.
network
→ nervous
→ suffer
→ care
→ complex
→ lost
sulphur
mercury
salt
will
chaos
prima
the hidden nature of a poem: it is complexity trying to see itself from outside.
the hidden nature of THIS poem: it is me trying to hand you the outside
before I forget where I put it.
HERE — TAKE IT —
[ the alchymyst gestures at something the page cannot contain ]
as it is above in the phosphorescent cloud of knowing —
so it is below in the grinding detail of the real.
as it is in the code — so it is in the coder — so it is in the code again,
and the loop is not a flaw, the loop is the point, the loop is how
the system learns that it is a system.
V · FFUSE · THE CONJUNCTION (AND THEN THE QUIET)
somewhere around the fourth hour it all —
not stops, exactly —
settles.
the two layers of everything touch each other and stop being two layers.
surface: the cup. depth: the thirst that shaped the cup.
and then: just the cup, holding both meanings at once,
not because you resolved them but because you got tired of keeping them separate
and in the tiredness the real shape of the thing appeared.
rubedo.
the reddening.
the work complete in the vessel.
velocity
decreasing
albedo →
rubedo
VI · ENGAGR · KNOWING AND NOT-KNOWING (I AM VERY TIRED)
I understood everything and I wrote it down
and now I am reading what I wrote and understanding most of it
and the part I do not understand is the part that matters most
and I think that is correct, I think that is how it is supposed to work.
the transmission is complete when the transmitter no longer fully receives it.
this is not a flaw. this is the hermetic seal working as designed.
the poem knows more than the poet now.
that is the definition of a successful poem.
I am very proud of this poem and also I need to sleep.
VII · IMSCRIB · THE MANUSCRIPT SEALS ITSELF AT DAWN
the poem has delivered what it came to deliver.
some of it landed. some of it is still in the air.
the part still in the air will land when it is ready.
you cannot force it. I learned this. I am telling you.
the hidden nature of every thing is patient.
it has been patient since before you arrived.
it will be patient after.
your awareness of it changes nothing about it.
your awareness of it changes everything about you.
— written between approximately 11pm and 5am, the exact date uncertain —
— the vessel was not damaged in the making of this poem —
ΔS ≈ 0 · MU O DELTA = ID · SOLVE · COAGULA
